$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file, for editor completion.

rowCountTables.description: Tables softure-deploy row-counts compares when --tables is not given: table or schema.table.

access.description: How deploy.sh reaches the database: host (default) connects to 127.0.0.1:5432 as postgres with POSTGRES_PASSWORD; compose-exec runs pg_dump and psql in the postgres service as POSTGRES_USER on POSTGRES_DB of .env.prod, for a Postgres that publishes no port.

appMigrations.description: An app's own migrations: the schema step refuses an image whose journal lists fewer entries than the ledger has rows.

journal.description: The app migrator's journal in the image, e.g. /app/drizzle/meta/_journal.json ({ "entries": [...] }).

ledger.description: The ledger table the app migrator fills; default drizzle.__drizzle_migrations.

excludeTableData.description: Tables whose rows stay out of deploy.sh's backups (their definition stays), e.g. a table of IP addresses.

database.description: Settings of the database steps of softure-deploy.

pre-migrate.description: After the backup, the schema guard and the row counts, before the switch (whose migrate service runs first); a failure puts the previous files back.

name.description: The hook's name: its step line in deploy.sh's output (step|<name>|ok).

compose.description: Arguments of docker compose --env-file .env.prod --file docker-compose.yml, e.g. ["run", "--rm", "migrate", "node", "import.mjs"].

name.description: The hook's name: its step line in deploy.sh's output (step|<name>|ok).

run.description: A command run on the host in the app folder, e.g. ["bash", "hooks/check-env.sh"] for a script the release ships in the compose file's folder (installed 0644, so call it through bash).

items.description: One app step: compose arguments or a host command; it gets TAG, IMAGE and PREVIOUS_TAG, its output goes to stderr.

post-up.description: After the release is live (tag recorded, cron installed); a failure fails the release and rolls nothing back.

maintain.description: After the daily backup and image cleanup, or on their own schedule.

compose.description: Arguments of docker compose --env-file .env.prod --file docker-compose.yml, e.g. ["run", "--rm", "migrate", "node", "import.mjs"].

schedule.description: Its own crontab line with this schedule (deploy.sh maintain <name>) instead of the daily maintain run.

name.description: The hook's name: its step line in deploy.sh's output (step|<name>|ok).

run.description: A command run on the host in the app folder, e.g. ["bash", "hooks/check-env.sh"] for a script the release ships in the compose file's folder (installed 0644, so call it through bash).

schedule.description: Its own crontab line with this schedule (deploy.sh maintain <name>) instead of the daily maintain run.

items.description: One app step of maintenance: in the daily maintain run, or on its own schedule.

hooks.description: App steps deploy.sh runs at named points of a deploy and of maintenance, in the listed order.

timeoutMs.description: Time one request may take, in milliseconds; --timeout overrides it.

headers.description: Header checks for every route (security headers); a route's own entry for the same name wins.

additionalProperties.description: Text the header value must contain (case-insensitive), a list of texts it must all contain, or null when the header must be absent.

path.description: Path on the verified URL, starting with /; a query string is allowed.

status.description: Expected HTTP status (redirects are not followed).

contains.description: Markers the response body must contain, for example a heading only the real page has.

excludes.description: Markers the response body must not contain, for example the text of an error page.

redirect.description: Expected Location of a redirect: a path on the verified URL or an absolute URL. Needs a 3xx status.

additionalProperties.description: Text the header value must contain (case-insensitive), a list of texts it must all contain, or null when the header must be absent.

headers.description: Headers by lower-case name: text (or a list of texts) the value must contain, or null when the header must be absent.

method.description: Request method. A POST route runs on every verify: make it one the app treats as a no-op or a check.

body.description: Request body, sent as is; set its content-type in requestHeaders. Not with GET or HEAD.

requestHeaders.description: Headers sent with the request, by lower-case name, on top of verify's own (user-agent, accept, cache-control).

items.description: One route to request and what its response must look like.

routes.description: Routes checked by softure-deploy verify, in report order.

tlsMinDays.description: Fewest days the TLS certificate of the verified https URL may have left; fewer, or an untrusted certificate, fails verify.

verify.description: What softure-deploy verify checks after a deploy.
